summary: Explain shared and private source drift and prepare one explicit transition that preserves both sides until apply.

outcomes: Explain source drift without merging configurations or exposing private content.
Plan a verified promotion or relocation with explicit deletion boundaries.

scenarios.title: Promote private project intent
scenarios.prompt: Use the reconcile-project-sources skill to compare the private and shared intent sources and prepare a safe promotion plan.
scenarios.outcome: A reviewed plan identifies semantic drift, the target authority, verification, and any separate deletion.

scenarios.title: Preserve divergent task queues
scenarios.prompt: Use the reconcile-project-sources skill to inspect shared and private todo queues without automatically merging them.
scenarios.outcome: Each queue remains independent and the report identifies only explicit actions the user may choose.
